individual.title: Individual project
individual.subtitle: You deliver it alone
points: Escrow is released to you in full on delivery
Direct chat with the project owner
No split shares or extra approvals

team.title: Team project
team.subtitle: Invite members and share the payout
points: An extra step to choose partners and split shares
Escrow is split between members by the agreed shares
Group chat, sub-threads and file sharing
A member joining or leaving needs the project owner's approval
team.warning: You can't switch to individual after the project is published

confirm.individualText: You'll deliver the project alone, and escrow is released to you in full on delivery.
confirm.teamText: You'll add team members and set each member's share before choosing the budget. Escrow is split by these shares on delivery.

budget.heading: Budget & duration
budget.hint: Tell providers what you need and how much you plan to spend
budget.projectTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Brand identity for a restaurant
budget.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the scope, deliverables and any references
budget.amountInvalid: Enter a budget of at least $10.
budget.durationInvalid: Enter a duration between 1 and 365 days.

team.heading: Team & split shares
team.hint: Invite members and set each member's share of the project value
team.sumHint: To continue, the total must be exactly 100% and every member must accept their invitation and share. Escrow isn't reserved until all members accept.
team.pendingTitle: Waiting for {count} member to accept — publishing on hold
team.pendingHint: Publishing can't be completed and the budget can't be reserved until every member accepts. If a member declines, their share returns to be redistributed.
rules: The project amount is held in escrow after all members accept
The project owner alone releases payouts — and only the finished member's share is released
A new member joining pauses the project and re-opens split approval for everyone
A member leaving returns their unearned share to be redistributed with approval
There's no automatic split on dispute — shares are fixed and not changed by force
The member's approved share on the platform isn't changed except by agreement
team.inviteUserPlaceholder: Search for a member on the platform
team.inviteNote: The member isn't counted in the team until they accept the invitation and share together.
team.footerNote: The total must equal 100% and every member must accept before publishing — escrow is reserved once everyone accepts.

publish.heading: Review & publish
publish.hint: Check your project details before publishing
publish.title: Title
publish.publishedText: Providers can now see your project and send their offers.

invitation.title: Invitation to join a project team
invitation.details: Your role: {role} · Total project value {total} · Your share is reserved in escrow after all members accept — your acceptance is one of the publishing conditions.
invitation.warning: By accepting you commit to delivering your role within the project duration. Changing your share later requires every member's approval.
invitation.accepted: You've joined the team. The project owner has been notified.
invitation.proposalSent: Your proposal has been sent to the project owner.

negotiate.title: Negotiate your share
negotiate.subtitle: Propose a different share with a short reason. Only the project owner sees it — the rest of the team doesn't.
negotiate.reduce: Must be reduced from other shares
negotiate.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The scope includes 6 extra screens that aren't in the description
negotiate.note: If your proposal is declined, you can accept the original share or keep negotiating. Shares are only final once everyone approves — no dispute can be opened before publishing.
